items.title: WattsOrbit v1.1.0
items.body:
## What's new

- **NewsBell in the tray popup** — unread dot and release-notes dropdown
- **News screen** in the Dashboard with markdown rendering and pull-to-refresh
- **UpdaterModal** replaces the old banner — changelog, download progress, in-app install
- **Homebrew Cask** auto-updates on every release publish

items.title: Keep the tray popup open
items.body: By default the tray popup hides when it loses focus. Hold ⌥ (Option) while clicking the menu-bar icon and the popup stays pinned — useful when you want to watch wattage drift while you do something else.
